text: Score and Change's overview of the 2026/2027 La Liga sponsors lists Osasuna's sleeve under 'Grupo Saltoki', with Celer Lighting on the home kit and Saltoki Home on the away and third kits, presenting Celer Lighting as a brand within the Grupo Saltoki family.
short: Celer Lighting as a Grupo Saltoki brand

source.name: Score and Change, Overview of the 2026/2027 La Liga sponsors
source.quote: Osasuna Grupo Saltoki: Celer Lighting (home) Saltoki Home (away & third) Lighting Building and interior design
source.note: Single-source link: neither saltoki.com nor its Iluminación division site mentions the Celer brand, and celer.es is a parked page. The row also carries the sector label 'Lighting / Building and interior design', consistent with Celer's product area.
